#### FPK2PA

#### Article 27

1. In order to protect and guarantee the rights of Women and Children from acts of violence, FPK2PA is established.  
2. FPK2PA as referred to in paragraph (1) consists of: a. Regional FPK2PA;  
   b. Sub-district FPK2PA; and c. Urban Village (Kelurahan) FPK2PA.  
3. The establishment of Regional FPK2PA as referred to in paragraph (2) letter a is determined by the Mayor.

##### I II

17 - (4) The establishment of sub-district FPK2PA as referred to in paragraph (2) letter b is determined by the sub-district head.  (5) The establishment of Urban Village (Kelurahan) FPK2PA as referred to in paragraph (2) letter c is determined by the urban village head.  (6) Further provisions regarding FPK2PA as referred to in paragraph (1) shall be regulated in a Mayor Regulation

# CHAPTER VI

## COMMUNITY PARTICIPATION

## Part One

Obligations and Responsibilities of Parents and/or Family

#### Article 28

Parents are obliged and responsible to:  a. care for, nurture, educate, manage and protect family members;  
b. develop family members in accordance with their abilities, talents, and interests; and  c. prevent marriage at the age of Children.

#### Article 29

Increasing the role of families in the Protection of Women and Children Victims of Violence is carried out through:  a. prevention of marriage at the age of Children;  
b. bringing Women closer to health services; and c. strengthening family resilience.

## Part Two

Community Involvement

#### Article 30

1. The community is involved in the Protection of Women and Children Victims of Violence.  
2. Community involvement as referred to in paragraph (1) is in the form of participation through prevention, services, empowerment, monitoring, supervision and fulfillment of the rights of Women and/or Children.

##### I II

18 - (3) The role of the community in the implementation of Protection of Women and Children Victims of Violence as referred to in paragraph (1) is carried out by:  a. providing communication and information through socialization and education regarding the rights of Women  and Children;  
b. providing suggestions and input in the formulation  of policies related to the Protection of Women and  Children;  
c. reporting to the competent authorities if there is  a violation of the rights of Women and  Children;  
d. playing an active role in the rehabilitation and  social reintegration process for Women and Children;  
e. forming family partners at the neighborhood association/community association or urban village (kelurahan) level by the community;  
f. forming Women and Children Protection units  within community organizations and educational institutions;  
g. establishment and management of orphanages;  
h. establishment of Child rehabilitation centers;  

i. provision of shelter houses and/or social;  

1. job skills training; and

J.  
k. providing first aid when violations of the rights of Women and Children occur.  (4) Further provisions regarding community participation shall be regulated by Mayor Regulation.

# CHAPTER VII

## GUIDANCE AND SUPERVISION

#### Article 31

1. The Mayor is obliged to carry out guidance and supervision of Children Victims of Violence.

Protection of Women and (2) The implementation of guidance and supervision as referred to in paragraph (1) is carried out by the Regional Apparatus that administers affairs in the field of Women's empowerment and Protection of Children Victims of Violence.

a. coordination;  
b. guidance;  
c. education and training;  
d. monitoring and evaluation; and e. reporting.  
4. Guidance and supervision as referred to in paragraph (1) to realize the objectives of the Protection of Women and Children in accordance with norms, standards, procedures, and criteria implemented by the Regional Apparatus that administers affairs in the field of Women's empowerment and Child Protection.  
5. Guidance and supervision as referred to in paragraph (1) is carried out with professional and transparent principles.  
6. In carrying out guidance and supervision as referred to in paragraph (1), the Regional Apparatus that administers affairs in the field of Women's empowerment and Child Protection must report regularly to the Mayor.  
7. In the case of guidance and supervision as referred to in paragraph (2), the Regional Apparatus that administers affairs in the field of Women's empowerment and Child Protection may cooperate and coordinate with other Regional Apparatus, the community, other agencies and/or organizational institutions.

# CHAPTER VIII

## EVALUATION

#### Article 32

(I) Evaluation of the Protection of Women and Children Victims of Violence is carried out based on documents of service implementation, empowerment, prevention, fulfillment and results of monitoring the implementation of the Protection of Women and Children.

##### I II

20 - (2) The implementation of evaluation as referred to in paragraph (1) is carried out by the Regional Apparatus that administers affairs in the field of Women's empowerment and Child Protection.

3. Evaluation as referred to in paragraph (1) includes process, impact and result evaluation.  
4. The results of the evaluation as referred to in paragraph (3) constitute material for the Mayor to prepare reports.

6. Further provisions regarding evaluation as referred to in paragraph (1) shall be regulated by Mayor Regulation.

# CHAPTER IX

## REPORTING

#### Article 33

1. Reporting as referred to in Article 32 paragraph (5) serves as material for the Mayor's consideration in making policy decisions on the implementation of the Protection of Women and Children Victims of Violence.  
2. Reports on the implementation of the Protection of Women and Children Victims of Violence as referred to in paragraph (1) are carried out 1 (one) time in 1 (one) year or at any time if necessary.
